entries.name: AppleAccountIntents_macOS
entries.note: n/a: App Intents of the Apple Account settings (sign in, account recovery and iCloud services) for Apple's account servers; the index shows only an ExtensionKit appex with Metadata.appintents. BifrOSt has its own BifrOSt Account pane with sign-in against BifrOSt Cloud (account_page.rs) and the open-account intent, which are separate features, not a mirror of the Apple account.

entries.name: AppleIDSettings
entries.note: n/a: the Apple Account pane (iCloud, media purchases, device list, recovery) for Apple's account servers; the index shows an appex with an Assets.car, icon and search terms for that pane. BifrOSt has its own BifrOSt Account pane and sign-in against BifrOSt Cloud (account_page.rs), a separate feature.
